svg.title: Wastewater operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as wastewater operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A submersible pump sits in an open sump and connects to a tall rising discharge pipe above the waterline. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
